min_standing_note.value: Nominated by home partner university; graduate exchange applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: For non-English official/native-language citizens: TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 120, OR signed official letter from home university confirming years of English study and college-level English proficiency. RHET 1020 waiver not stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Rule introduced on #page=6 and test cutoffs listed on #page=7.

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency required for non-English native countries unless home-university English proficiency letter submitted.

tuition_model.notes: Tuition waiver granted up to maximum load of 16 credit hours per semester.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived by dividing 1-semester exchange living items on #page=7 (Housing $3,500–$5,000 + Food $2,550 + Transportation $700 = $6,750–$8,250/semester, excluding Books $450, International Fee $50, Transcript $18, and Insurance $500–$950) by 5 months = $1,350–$1,650/mo.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1-semester USD midpoint estimate: ($3,500–$5,000 Housing + $2,550 Food + $700 Transport = $6,750–$8,250, midpoint $7,500.00 USD; excludes Books $450 and Insurance $500–$950; compare DS-2019 minimum proof $7,615/sem noted on abroad.ucf.edu). Recorded 2026-11-15.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory adequate health insurance per Florida Board of Governors (UCF Health Insurance ~$500–$950/sem depending on coverage); mandatory immunizations prior to registration; International Fee $50, Transcript $18. Lynx Orlando buses and UCF Shuttle free with UCF ID.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Insurance & immunization policies stated on #page=6; fee figures on #page=7.

housing_availability.notes: Students secure their own off-campus or UCF-partnered accommodation (The Verge ~$4,999/sem incl. utilities w/ deposits waived; UnionWest for Main/Downtown; Rosen apartments for Hospitality students).

housing_notes.value: Partnered off-campus/campus-adjacent options: The Verge (~$4,999/sem all-inclusive utilities, security/background fees waived), UnionWest (Downtown/Main), and Rosen College apartments (Hospitality); Housing instructions sent June (Fall) / Nov (Spring).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 visa (Form DS-2019) required; must submit passport copy, English proficiency proof, financial documentation (abroad.ucf.edu notes $7,615/sem minimum proof), and Affidavit of Support.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Document list continues on #page=7; DS-2019 proof $7,615/sem also noted on https://abroad.ucf.edu/.

exchange_page_url.notes: Also referenced as studyabroad.ucf.edu in UCF Fact Sheet #page=8.

course_catalog_url.notes: Students search courses interactively via my.ucf.edu -> Class Search or Browse Course Catalog (`UCF Fact Sheet 2026-2027.pdf#page=3`).

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit hours (standard course = 3 credits): UG min 12 credits, GR min 9 credits; maximum load covered by tuition waiver is 16 credits.

course_restrictions_note.value: UG cannot enroll in 5000+ level courses; Master's students limited to <=6000; PhD any level. Prerequisite courses require department approval contingent on transcript.

value: Non-Degree Seeking UCF Application + UCF Abroad online profile
Most recent official academic transcript (+ proof of current enrolled courses if absent)
Registration Worksheet signed by home/host academic advisor
Passport copy + English proficiency proof (or home-university letter)
Financial Documentation & Affidavit of Support for DS-2019
required_application_docs.notes: DS-2019 financial/passport/English docs on #page=6–7; application steps on #page=2.

campus_type.notes: Three Orlando campuses open to exchange students: UCF Main Campus (East Orlando), UCF Downtown Campus, and Rosen College of Hospitality Management (West Orlando).

international_support_services.value: UCF Abroad advising, Global Knights Society student organization, UCF Health Center, SARC tutoring, CAPS, SAS accessibility, complimentary Lynx transit & campus shuttle.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall 2026: partner nomination March 1, student application June 1. Spring 2027: partner nomination September 1, student application October 30.
